title: Forgetting and lower bounds for every support
claim: If the exact unobserved finite interface relation has a nonempty positive power equal to the product of its two actual projections, every finite bond from a group-0 variable to a group-s variable has at least 1+ceil(s/r) members, with arbitrary off-branch and later support. A uniform canonical-link cycle with identity carries gives a fresh own endpoint at every depth and a bond of size at most s+3. Genuine controls refute converses and endpoint existence from the bare relation alone. Free physical interfaces give a separate bounded cross-bond certificate.
standard_statement: For a nonempty constraint system decomposed by finite exact interfaces, a rectangular relation power implies a uniform linear cardinality lower bound for minimal non-shattered sets spanning groups. Exact per-input canonical link tables with neutral identity carries give a sufficient linear upper bound; their conjunction certifies linear growth. Countermodels show that the unobserved relation alone does not decide existence, growth or boundedness; a positive cross-interface certificate requires free physical interface sets.
prior_work: Finite Boolean relation composition, primitive powers and separation are classical (Wielandt 1950; Chajda-Langer 2021/2022). Accepted BONDS-AND-COUNT E gives one full three-step instance; the local delta is the arbitrary-support rectangular-power theorem, the exact link/carry upper certificate and the checked failures of converse/existence claims. No field novelty is asserted.

validation.status: hand arguments plus separately derived same-task finite relation encodings, exact NAE projections, deletion tests and knotlab
validation.field_novelty: unassessed; classical ingredients not claimed new

foundation_claim_scope: Minimal nonshattered supports in the allowed states of supplied nested relations. No finite-flip source or frequency assertion.
completion_gate: Uniform arbitrary-support implication, exact upper certificate and substantive positive/negative controls proved and focused checks passed. General necessary-and-sufficient endpoint classification is outside the attained claim.
